title: Backpack Feature Explorer with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a Backpack Feature Explorer with undo/redo functionality. Use GLTFLoader to load 'Duck.glb' as a placeholder 3D model representing the backpack product.

## Scene Setup
- Set up a Three.js scene with a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at the origin.
- Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.5) and a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 7) with intensity 1.0.
- Add a subtle ground plane (circle geometry, radius 3, gray material) at y=0.
- Load 'Duck.glb' using GLTFLoader. Center the model at the origin. Scale it so it fits roughly within a 2-unit bounding box.
- Set the background color to #1a1a2e.
- Add OrbitControls for camera interaction.

## Feature Hotspots
Create 5 clickable hotspot markers (small spheres, radius 0.08) placed around the model at these positions:
- Hotspot 1 'Padded Straps': position (0.5, 1.5, 0.3), color red (#ff4444)
- Hotspot 2 'Main Compartment': position (0, 1.0, 0.5), color green (#44ff44)
- Hotspot 3 'Side Pocket': position (-0.7, 0.8, 0.2), color blue (#4444ff)
- Hotspot 4 'Laptop Sleeve': position (0, 1.2, -0.4), color yellow (#ffff44)
- Hotspot 5 'Water Bottle Holder': position (0.7, 0.6, 0.3), color cyan (#44ffff)

Each hotspot should pulse (scale oscillation between 0.8 and 1.2 using sin wave).

## Color Customization
Create 4 color swatch buttons in the DOM (top-right corner) for customizing the model's material color:
- 'Navy' (#1a237e) - button id='color-navy'
- 'Forest' (#1b5e20) - button id='color-forest'
- 'Crimson' (#b71c1c) - button id='color-crimson'
- 'Charcoal' (#424242) - button id='color-charcoal'

Default color is Navy. When a swatch is clicked, change the model's main material color. Each color change is an undoable action.

## Feature Selection
When a hotspot is clicked (via raycasting on click), that feature becomes 'selected':
- The hotspot scales up to 1.5x and stays enlarged (no more pulsing).
- A DOM info panel (id='info-panel') appears at the bottom of the screen showing the feature name and a short description.
- The model rotates smoothly (over 0.5s) to face the hotspot toward the camera.
- Each feature selection is an undoable action.

## Undo/Redo System
- Add two DOM buttons: 'Undo' (id='btn-undo') and 'Redo' (id='btn-redo') in the top-left corner.
- Also support keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z for undo, Ctrl+Y for redo.
- Maintain an action history stack and a redo stack.
- Undoable actions: color changes and feature selections.
- Undo reverts the last action (restores previous color or deselects feature).
- Redo re-applies the undone action.
- Disable (set disabled attribute) undo button when history is empty, redo button when redo stack is empty.
- Maximum history size: 20 actions.

## Rotation Control
- Add a 'Spin' toggle button (id='btn-spin') that toggles auto-rotation of the model around Y axis at 0.5 rad/s.
- Default: spin is OFF.
- Toggling spin is NOT an undoable action.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- modelLoaded: boolean, true when Duck.glb is loaded
- currentColor: string, current hex color of the model (e.g. '#1a237e')
- selectedFeature: number or null, index (1-5) of currently selected hotspot, null if none
- featureName: string, name of selected feature or '' if none
- historyLength: number, length of undo history stack
- redoLength: number, length of redo stack
- spinEnabled: boolean, whether auto-rotation is on
- hotspotCount: number, should be 5
- undoDisabled: boolean, whether undo button is disabled
- redoDisabled: boolean, whether redo button is disabled
- modelRotationY: number, current Y rotation of the model in radians
- infoPanelVisible: boolean, whether the info panel is currently shown

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.

## UI Styling
- All buttons should have padding 10px 16px, border-radius 6px, cursor pointer.
- Color swatches should be 40x40px circles showing their respective colors.
- Info panel should have a dark semi-transparent background, white text, and smooth slide-up animation.
- Add a title 'Backpack Explorer' at the top center (id='title-text').
physics_constraints: Hotspot pulsing should follow sin wave timing. Model rotation on feature select should interpolate smoothly. Auto-rotation speed must be consistent at 0.5 rad/s. All state values must remain NaN-free.
